issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-9208](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-9208)
### Description

This issue tracks the fixup process for the indexes impacted by #19933.

On master startup, the master identifies the set of indexes for which retain_delete_markers is set to true, checks with master if the index build is still in progress. If not, then the master can go ahead and fixup the metadata - set retain_delete_markers to false and persist the changes locally (so that the subsequent restart no longer needs to perform the fixup again).
